name: badge
title: Badge
description: Status labels, product tags, and site chips.
usage: A run's or monitor's status (`default` for paused or queued, `brand` running, `success`, `warning` skipped, `destructive` failed), `tag` for a tag, `chip` for the site's pill-shaped labels.
avoid: More than one tone per row

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
